text: Psychology is a discipline that studies human psychological phenomena, behaviors and the underlying mechanisms. It not only focuses on the internal psychological processes such as cognition, emotion and motivation of individuals, but also explores the interaction between psychology and physiology, as well as the social environment. The following introduces the relevant content of psychology from multiple dimensions for you:Discipline Positioning and Core ObjectivesThe nature of the discipline: Psychology is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates knowledge from multiple fields such as biology, sociology, philosophy, and neuroscience, and possesses the dual attributes of both natural and social sciences.Core objective:Describe the manifestations and characteristics of psychological phenomena (such as emotions, memories, personalities, etc.);Explain the causes and mechanisms of mental activities (such as why people develop biases and how they learn new knowledge);Predict the behavioral responses of individuals in specific situations; Intervention and improvement of psychological states (such as solving psychological problems through psychological counseling)
